enchantments.tooltip: Sacred +3: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +3 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.

Insightful Faith: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Insightful Faith items provide Insight Bonuses to the owner's effective level for the turning check by +2, their maximum Hit Dice turned by +2, and their total Hit Dice turned by +4.
Physical Sheltering +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Insightful Fortification +28%: +28% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
